scope: M2 continuous existing-queue playback and official Spotify feature-scope research
behaviors: Default-on persisted Keep playing preference; explicit opt-out
Ordered cycles wrap existing queue without growth
Fresh shuffled cycle commits order/final report/selection/receipt atomically
Avoid just-ended musical identity when another one is playable
Unavailable/all-unavailable and duplicate occurrences remain bounded
Repeat-one precedence and manual skip semantics
Next-round preview; changing-song handoff does not claim a remote queue change
retainedFailures: Shuffle preview assertion initially ran before playback was resumed
Phone queue-control row initially hid part of the first upcoming song; tightened without reducing touch targets
Finite-ending setup tried to use a hidden empty-queue control; changed to the always-reachable full-player preference
limitations: Library context is still the currently rendered bounded page, not whole-library continuation
Previous follows visible current-cycle order, not a separate cross-round audible-history stack
No recommendation autoplay, crossfade/true-gapless DSP, offline downloaded music or M3 identity/remote work
Physical Android checks remain deferred; inherited privilege/opt-in tests explicitly skipped
privacy: No personal song names, covers, host paths, credentials or raw attempts in this export.
